findings.finding: The new physical located-error check calls capture.LINK.LINK.ERR.findall(log_text) on the entire multiline log. The pinned production ERR regex in overnight-helper/check-helper.py is anchored with ^/$ but has no re.MULTILINE, so findall only considers the start of the entire string; a located `verified/lib.rs(...): error: ...` after the refusal marker is not rejected. The synthetic test hides this production mismatch: FakeCapture compiles its equivalent regex with re.M, so `error-with-refusal` is rejected in tests while the real pinned matcher returns no match. Thus an exit-2 mode-9 log can contain the valid refusal marker, then a located verifier error, plus complete snapshots and still pass the adapter's physical log check (assuming the existing intended classification is reported). Iterate over physical lines and call the pinned matcher per line (or use a precisely equivalent multiline matcher), and make the fake use the exact pinned regex/behavior before approving.
findings.fix: Apply the production ERR matcher line-by-line (or compile an equivalent with explicit multiline behavior), and align FakeCapture with the exact pinned regex. Add/retain a regression with refusal marker first and a located error on a later line.
